model.name: Reservation notice delivery
model.description: A resource owner commits reservation intentions; explicit dispatch and delivery submit typed notices to an independently owned reservation ledger. Scripted faults and retries demonstrate receipt deduplication, not external delivery or a distributed transaction.
model.author: LCE Studio contributors

machine.name: Owned resource reservation
machine.description: One serialized resource owner with durable availability and a volatile accepted-command counter. Accepted commands commit a reservation notice intent; no external delivery, pharmacy-specific rules or authorization enforcement is implied.
machine.author: LCE Studio contributors

package.name: Reserve available resource
package.description: Pure bounded decision for one owned resource. Matching target, positive quantity and sufficient nonnegative availability permit a reservation. Returns proposed values and a notice; the state host controls commits and effect intents.

machine.name: Owned reservation ledger
machine.description: Owns an independently committed total of typed reservation notices. Durable command receipts deduplicate the frozen generated delivery command; volatile acceptance count resets to the effective per-instance baseline. No external database or authorization enforcement is provided.
